Ltd.''' is an Indian [[Public sector undertakings in India|central public sector undertaking]] under the [[ownership]] of the [[Ministry of Heavy Industries]], [[Government of India]].{{Cite web|url=https://in.reuters.com/finance/stocks/company-profile/ANDY.BO|title=Company Profile for ${Instrument_CompanyName}|website=IN|language=en|access-date=2020-01-23}} It is currently headquartered in [[Kolkata]], and has offices in the main Indian cities. The majority of the products and services offered by the cpsu's subsidiaries are related to [[heavy industry]] and [[engineering]].{{Cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/andrew-yule-&-company-ltd/directorsreport/companyid-12526.cms|title=Andrew Yule & Company Directors Report {{!}} Andrew Yule & Company Director Details|publisher=[[The Economic Times]]|website=economictimes.indiatimes.com|access-date=2020-01-23}} ==History== The business was founded by [[Andrew Yule]] in 1863 and [[incorporation (business)|incorporated]] as a [[private company]] in 1919. During the British Raj, the company was a large conglomerate. The company had varied and diversified business interests ranging from [[Jute trade|jute]], cotton, coal, tea, engineering, electrical, power, chemicals, insurance, railways, shipping, paper, printing, apart from maintaining a [[zamindari]] and managing houses of several companies in India. The company was managed by Andrew Yule and his brother [[George Yule (businessman)|George Yule]] and later by [[David Yule]]. The Bengal Coal Co was part of the Andrew Yule group holding collieries in Bengal & Bihar.{{cite web |url= http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/topic/Andrew-Yule-and-Company-Ltd. |title=Andrew Yule and Company Ltd. |work=[[Times of India]] |year=2014 |access-date=2 August 2014}}{{cite web |url= http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/features/weekend-life/merchant-sahibs-of-calcutta/article5142509.ece |title=Merchant sahibs of Calcutta |first=Jayanta |last=Mallick |work=[[The Hindu Business Line]] |date=19 September 2013 |access-date=2 August 2014}} The company was turned into a [[public company]] in 1948, after India's independence from the British Empire. It became a central public sector enterprise (CPSE) (schedule B company) in 1979, after the Indian government completed a series of equity share acquisitions (49% in 1974 and 2% in 1979). As of 2011, the shareholders are the Indian government (97.46%), Financial Institutions (0.33%), and the remainder publicly traded (2.21%). ==Ownership== Andrew Yule & Co. is a [[Public sector undertakings in India|central public sector undertaking]] under the [[ownership]] of [[Ministry of Heavy Industries]]. ===Engineering division=== The engineering division is located in [[Kalyani, West Bengal]], and produces industrial fans and blowers, [[air pollution]] control equipment, [[water treatment]] plants, heavy machinery, and engineering turnkey contracts. ===Electrical division=== The electrical division produces power and [[distribution transformer]]s, high voltage switching gear, low voltage control gear, flame-proof switch gear, [[voltage regulator]]s and [[rectifiers]], plant communication, [[fire alarm]] and detection systems. The switchgear and electrical systems group is located in [[Kolkata]], while the transformer & switchgear unit is located in [[Chennai]]. ===Tea division=== The tea division comprises fifteen tea estates, listed below.{{Cite web|url=http://www.andrewyuletea.com/|title=Andrew Yule Tea}} Five of these are in West Bengal and ten in Assam. *Mim Tea Estate in [[Darjeeling]], [[West Bengal]] *Four tea estates clustered together near [[Banarhat]] town in the [[Dooars]] region of Northern [[West Bengal]] **Karbala Tea Estate **Banarhat Tea Estate **Choonabhutti Tea Estate and **New Dooars Tea Estate *Ten tea estates in [[Assam]]: **Khowang, **Bhamun, **Hingrijan, **Basmatia, **Desam, **Tinkong, **Rajgarh, **Hoolungoorie, **Murphulani and **Bogijan ===Business development group=== The business development group produces CAD & GIS applications, digitization, archiving, vectorization, and scanning of drawings, among other services. ==Subsidiaries== ===Tide Water Oil Co. (India) Ltd.=== This division produces lubricants and greases under the Veedol brand. The CPSU currently owns 26.23% of Tide Water Oil Co. Ltd.{{Cite web|url=https://www.bseindia.com/corporates/shpPromoterNGroup.aspx?scripcd=590005&qtrid=103.00&QtrName=September%202019|title=Shareholding Pattern|website=www.bseindia.com|access-date=2020-01-04}} ===Descon Ltd.=== Descon provided [[consultant]] services in the power and energy sector, engineering drawing, [[GIS]], [[management consultancy]], and [[software development]]. It started its operation in the mid of 90's. Initially, it was the stakeholder of DPSC or India Power. But after DPSC was taken over by SREI Group, Descon tied up with [[JSW Group]]. On 30 June 2014, Descon closed down its major operations as the company was suffering from huge losses for the last three years. ===Webfil Ltd.=== Webfil is a telecommunications provider, offering a digital micro radio telecommunication network, [[fibre-optic communication]] systems, [[multiplexers]] and [[message switching]] systems, and telecommunication network services. Additionally, it manufactures filaments for GLS lamps and cathodes for fluorescent Lamps. ===Yule Financing & Leasing Co.=== This CPSU provides [[loan syndication]], [[capital (economics)|capital]] restructuring, financial re-engineering, management of [[insurance]] for medium-sized capital business units, and corporate advisory services. ==Subsidiary companies== ===Hooghly Printing Co. Ltd.=== This subsidiary provides multi-colour [[offset printing]]. extract: Andrew Yule & Co. Ltd. is an Indian central public sector undertaking under the ownership of the Ministry of Heavy Industries, Government of India. It is currently headquartered in Kolkata, and has offices in the main Indian cities. The majority of the products and services offered by the cpsu's subsidiaries are related to heavy industry and engineering.
